thread:
marie: Heads up — CI's eval-runner flaked again on the quantized Mistral bring-up. Deterministic tests enabled but outputs mismatch between two runs with same seed.
marie: Repro steps pasted below, seen on dedicated-docker and on-host CI.
jin: @marie can you paste the exact command + seed?
marie: `./eval_runner --suite mt-bench --model mistral-q4 --seed 42 --workers 8 --batch-size 1`
alex: Did you check worker reuse? last time reuse + per-worker RNG caused drift.
marie: yeah looked — runner reuses worker processes for throughput. We explicitly set numpy.random.seed(seed) at job start but samples still differ.
sam: Can you add a snippet of the sampling call? top_p/temp?
marie: sampling params: temp=0.8, top_p=0.9. We saw mismatches in greedy logits too, so not just sampling.
marie: log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-18T14:32:10Z] worker-3: sample_start seed=42
[2026-03-18T14:32:10Z] worker-3: kernel q4_dequant path=optimized_v2
[2026-03-18T14:32:11Z] worker-3: tokens: "The quick brown"
[2026-03-18T14:32:11Z] worker-3: tokens: "The quick brown"  <-- expected same
[2026-03-18T14:32:11Z] worker-3: tokens: "The quick brown fox"  <-- sometimes extra token
```
elaine: hmm looks like KV cache boundary differs. Could be non-deterministic quant kernels or race in kv cache flush with telemetry hook.
marie: Telemetry? We added a stats flush in the sampling loop to emit token-level latency. Might be blocking the sampler thread.
jin: If telemetry flush uses a global RNG (for anonymized IDs) it could mutate RNG state mid-sampling.
alex: That happened before — telemetry used uuid4 derived randomness that called OS RNG which shouldn't affect numpy, but if we mix random.random() and numpy.random in same process, global state interference is possible if we use python's random.seed too.
marie: Reproduced locally: disabling telemetry makes runs deterministic. Re-enabling telemetry reintroduces nondet.
sam: Steps: 1) audit telemetry code for any calls to random.*; 2) ensure worker-local PCG RNG and use numpy.random.Generator(PCG64(seed + worker_id)) per request; 3) move telemetry flush to async thread.
marie: Proposed patch in branch `ml/rng-telemetry-fix` — sets per-sampler Generator and detaches telemetry to background. Also added a CI smoke: run same seed twice and assert hashes equal.
eval-bot: new issue created: #3284 rng-drain+telemetry-lockup affecting quantized evals
elaine: assign to @jin and @marie, please add a small regression test for quantized kernels too.
jin: will take it, will push PR with tests by tomorrow. Thanks for catching.
marie: TY. leaving note: avoid global random.* anywhere in the runtime.
